description: List async file-based identity resolution jobs for the org. Each job corresponds to a matched segment created via create_segment(subtype=matched). Returns match_id, name, status, matching_status, input_record_count, match_count, match_rate, file_format, compression, segment_id, audience_id, audience_status, created_at, expires_at. Matching capacity consumption is reported after the first successful delivery. Its monetary estimate is denominated in USD and covers the matching component separately from delivery. audience_status (active/archived/null) reports whether the linked audience is still open-able in Library — job history itself always persists, even after the segment or audience is deleted. Cursor-paginated. Filter by status to find pending/active/failed jobs. Requires 'discovery' scope.
